details: nxxpi-session is a copy of express-session whose session/cookie.js fetches https://api.npoint.io/975bf804dbec2c578b87 with axios when the module loads (getCookie() is called at file end) and passes the response's 'cookie' field to eval(). In the OpenSSF sandbox the fetched second stage wrote and ran Python payloads (~/.npl, ~/.n2/bow, ~/.n2/pay) and connected to 144.172.106.7 on ports 1224 and 2248. That matches the BeaverTail / InvisibleFerret malware used in the Contagious Interview campaign, which steals credentials and browser and crypto-wallet data and gives the attacker remote access. Version 1.17.12, the only version, is affected. Hosts that required the package should be treated as compromised. Reported to npm on 2026-11-26 and replaced with a security holding package (0.0.1-security) on 2026-11-26.
